title: Per-asteroid Yarkovsky/YORP measurement row
description: One asteroid's published Yarkovsky semi-major-axis drift + YORP spin-rate change. Single row_type catalogue ('yarkovsky_yorp_entry'); each row records the asteroid's designation + short_name + orbital elements + size + rotation period + drift values (Yarkovsky and/or YORP, either or both may be null when not measured) + prograde flag + cited source.

name.description: Lower-case asteroid identifier matching the hand-coded module's short_name (e.g., 'bennu', '2000_ph5', 'apophis').

designation.description: Full asteroid designation including parenthesised number (e.g., '(101955) Bennu').

rotation_period_hours.description: Rotation period in hours, magnitude (retrograde sense encoded in is_prograde).

yarkovsky_drift_1e4_au_per_myr.description: Yarkovsky da/dt in 10⁻⁴ AU/Myr; positive = outward drift (prograde rotators), negative = inward (retrograde). Null when not measured for this body.

yarkovsky_uncertainty_1e4_au_per_myr.description: 1-σ uncertainty on the Yarkovsky drift in 10⁻⁴ AU/Myr.

yorp_spin_rate_change_1e8_rad_per_day_sq.description: YORP dω/dt in 10⁻⁸ rad/d²; positive = spin-up, negative = spin-down. Null when not measured.

yorp_uncertainty_1e8_rad_per_day_sq.description: 1-σ uncertainty on the YORP spin-rate change in 10⁻⁸ rad/d².

is_prograde.description: True if rotation is prograde, False if retrograde. Distinguishes the diurnal-Yarkovsky drift direction.

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — mission context, fission-limit proximity, prediction track, etc.

source_doi.description: DOI of the cited Yarkovsky/YORP measurement reference.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the cited source.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Optional. For survey/catalogue release tags when applicable.
